name: Altstadt (Old Town Core)
description: The walled heart of Rothenburg, centered on the Marktplatz and Rathaus, with cobbled lanes, timbered houses, and towers at every turn. It is the most atmospheric place to stay, busy with day-trippers by afternoon and beautifully quiet at dawn and after dusk when the coaches leave.
vibe: Historic, picturesque, tourist-facing by day and hushed by night
bestFor: Culture lovers who want to live inside the postcard
pros: Cafes, shops, and sights on your doorstep
cons: Crowded and touristy during peak hours
Rentals carry a small premium and are scarce

name: Plonlein and Spitaltor Quarter
tagline: The most-photographed corner and southern gate
description: The southern stretch of the old town around the famous forked-street Plonlein and the Spitaltor bastion. It is intensely scenic, full of half-timbered charm and fortified gateways, and slightly removed from the busiest Marktplatz core, giving a quieter feel while staying inside the walls.
vibe: Iconic, romantic, camera-ready yet a touch calmer
bestFor: Those wanting classic views with a bit more quiet
pros: Steps from the walls and Spitaltor gate
Slightly calmer than the central square
cons: The Plonlein itself draws steady crowds

name: Bahnhof Area (Outside the Walls)
tagline: Practical living by the train station
description: The residential area just east of the old town around the Bahnhof, Rothenburg's small train station. It trades medieval drama for everyday convenience, with more ordinary housing, easier parking, and quick foot access to both the walls and rail connections toward Steinach.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting value and easy transport
cons: Lacks the historic charm of the walls

name: Tauber Valley and Detwang
tagline: Green riverside calm below the town
description: The peaceful valley below Rothenburg, including the old village of Detwang with its historic church, threaded by the Tauber river and walking and cycling trails. It offers a rural, scenic base close to nature yet only a short climb or ride up to the walled town.
bestFor: Nature lovers craving quiet and countryside
pros: Trails and cycling on the doorstep
cons: A walk or ride from town amenities
